metadata.description: The skill shelf of Nihar Bhagat — a personal collection of Claude skills built for designers, frontend developers, and people applying to design, product, and frontend roles. MIT-licensed.

plugins.name: lay-ui
plugins.description: Translates Figma designs into production-ready code using a three-station component-first workflow. Requires the Figma MCP server.

plugins.name: roll-lint
plugins.description: Systems-design-aware CSS/SCSS auditor. Cleans stylesheets through seven dependency-ordered phases, returns a blueprint of the surviving patterns, and keeps guarding them with baseline-driven touch-up mode and an edit hook.

plugins.name: run-candidacy
plugins.description: One job at a time. Tailored resume, application answers, and outreach contacts — generated from your own facts, written in your own voice.
